title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces Fee Schedule by Bed Class
content:
Fee schedule amounts for Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces, in US dollars, for each bed class: the fee-schedule purchase amount of the billed class; the fee-schedule rental for each of months 1 through 3 of the class (per month); the fee-schedule rental for each month from month 4 on (per month); the rule fixing the first day of each rental month; and whether a signed notice is required before the upgrade difference over the billed class is charged.

| Bed class | Fee-schedule purchase amount | Rental, each of months 1 through 3 | Rental, each month from month 4 on | Rule fixing each rental month's first day | Signed notice required before the upgrade difference is charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | $1120.00 | $112.00 | $84.00 | delivery-date anniversary | No |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | $1310.00 | $131.00 | $98.25 | delivery-date anniversary | No |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | $1486.40 | $148.64 | $111.48 | delivery-date anniversary | No |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | $1958.00 | $195.80 | $146.85 | delivery-date anniversary | Yes |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | $2640.00 | $264.00 | $198.00 | delivery-date anniversary | No |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | $6980.00 | $698.00 | $523.50 | delivery-date anniversary | No |

## Schedule notes

1. The two rental columns are monthly amounts. A month numbered 1, 2 or 3 is read from the first rental column; a month numbered 4 or higher is read from the second.
2. The rule fixing each rental month's first day is the delivery-date anniversary for every class.
3. A signed notice before the upgrade difference over the billed class is charged is required for the Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) only; for the other five classes the schedule records No.
4. The amounts are fee-schedule amounts, not allowed amounts; this schedule states no coverage percentage.

## Reading a row (hypothetical month numbers)

| Hypothetical month of the rental | Class | Column read | Fee-schedule amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Month 3 | Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | months 1 through 3 | $131.00 |
| Month 4 | Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | month 4 on | $98.25 |
| Month 1 | Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | months 1 through 3 | $264.00 |
| Month 10 | Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | month 4 on | $523.50 |

Month 3 and month 4 sit on either side of the change between the two rental columns.
